outcomes.outcomeIntentOriginalParaphrase: Add two four-digit numbers with exactly one regrouping, total no more than 10,000.
Add two four-digit numbers with two regroupings, total no more than 10,000.
Estimate addition results by rounding both addends to the nearest ten.
Create and extend addition patterns with results within 10,000.
Describe and apply addition to everyday quantities.
Subtract up to four-digit numbers without regrouping in practical situations.
Subtract up to four-digit numbers with regrouping and explain place-value exchanges.
Estimate a subtraction difference by rounding operands to the nearest ten.
Create subtraction patterns using numbers up to 10,000.
Explain and apply subtraction to everyday remainder and comparison problems.
